messages.subject: users group passes 1000 members
parts:
If we don't want to be ruled by the tyrrany
of human digits, we can be ruled by the tyrrany of
computer digits and celebrate at 1024.

Of course, many of those users are likely to be drive-bys
and many people have registered more than once, so it's
not a good measure of real use. I think the traffic on
the list is the only indicator of that.

- Bob
